KOS ROV operated TA Cap running tool is designed for running wellhead caps on wireline, and has too weak and simple design for retrieving trawl frames. If the frame is locked to the wellhead with shear pins that requires 3-5 tons overpull, the locking bolts in the ROV operated tool would probably be too weak and may break when taking the necessary overpull.
